RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, so an all-female panel selecting her does not indicate sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation within municipal networks. 

At the director level, councils and executives often prioritize political acumen, public consultation experience, and interview chemistry over formal credentials and tenure. The delayed response to your feedback request is standard municipal administrative delay, not evidence of misconduct. 

Instead of focusing on the panel's demographics, send a polite follow-up email requesting constructive feedback on specific leadership competencies to help inform your future applications.
